Priya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the chat completions surface for the next milestone. customers pushing for clear roles + smooth migration from prompt-style APIs.
Mateo (Eng): TL;DR: two main options — keep `prompt` (string) + `messages` (array) dual-mode, or pick one canonical shape. Both have infra/runtime impact.
Casey (Product): Customer asks summarized: enterprise legal teams want an enforceable `system` role that can't be implicitly injected by clients; platform teams want minimal delta for existing prompt users.
Erin (DevEx): Docs/SDK work will be huge if we support both modes. If we pick `messages` as canonical, we can auto-convert `prompt` -> `messages` for a migration path. That reduces churn in examples.
Alex (ML): Model-side: messages array (role-tagged) maps cleanly to all our evaluation tooling. But note some open models expect raw prompt concatenation; we may need small adapters.
Jordan (CS): Several customers asked for explicit `assistant` content in the request (to prime continuation), and for a protected `system` that can't be overwritten by downstream prompts. They call it "system enforcement."
Mateo (Eng): Runtime concerns: preserving `system` enforcement requires server-side enforcement layer and telemetry to detect when clients attempt to override. Also need to decide if `system` is single string or array of system messages.
Priya (PM): Proposal: primary API shape = `messages` (array of {role, content, name?}). Keep `prompt` as deprecated convenience param with automatic conversion. Launch criteria: SDKs + docs updated, migration script in console, canary with 2 major customers, and perf regression <5%.
Casey (Product): Scope negotiation: v1 must include message roles (system/user/assistant) + simple function-calling compat. Structured output and granular assistant tags can be v1.1.
Erin (DevEx): For function/tool calling we should include `message.role == "tool"` or keep `function_call` flag? Customers prefer explicit `tool` role in stream for observability.
Alex (ML): Suggestion: support `function_call` meta + `tool` role for emitted tool outputs. Aligns with model signals.
Mateo (Eng): Implementation note: we'll need to extend KV caching and prefix caching to be role-aware (system prefixes should have a different cache policy). Also batching must respect message role boundaries for safety.
Priya (PM): Security ask: enterprises want `system.locked=true` at the request level so downstream clients (internal proxies) can't mutate system content. Add as opt-in request-level flag.
Jordan (CS): Add-on ask from support: api should return a migration header if we auto-convert `prompt` => `messages` e.g., `x-redwood-migration: prompt-to-messages` so customers can detect changes.
Casey (Product): Launch checklist items: 1) API spec finalized; 2) Node/Python SDKs release; 3) migration guide; 4) E2E tests with function calling; 5) perf benchmarks and a public note on behavior differences.
Mateo (Eng): Risks: adapter layer for `prompt` increases latency slightly — need perf numbers. Also model adapters for older/3rd-party models could change output tokenization -> potential quality regressions. We should include automatic A/B test on quality metrics.
Erin (DevEx): UX: sample patterns for common conversions (prompt -> single user message, system injection examples). Include quickstart snackable snippets.
Priya (PM): Decision call: move ahead with `messages`-first API, support `prompt` as deprecated convenience with automatic conversion + migration header, prototype system.locked flag, include `tool` role and `function_call` meta. Prioritize SDK + migration doc in launch.
Alex (ML): For rollout: canary on hosted for 2 weeks with traffic split and regression alerts tied to evals + token-level cost delta.
Jordan (CS): I'll coordinate with the two customers for canary access and collect feedback.
Mateo (Eng): I'll scope infra work and post estimates by EOD tomorrow.
infra-bot: deployment status: canary-environment created for chat-shape-prototype (build #482). :rocket:
Priya (PM): Great. Next steps: Mateo posts estimate, Erin starts doc skeleton, Casey finalizes launch criteria, Alex configures evals. We'll reconvene Fri 10am. :calendar:
